visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with her hair tied back stands in an indoor room featuring light-colored wooden flooring and a large wooden wardrobe. She wears a striking black spiked wig that extends outward in several sharp directions, black sunglasses, and a black-and-white horizontally striped wavy shirt paired with black sweatpants. She performs rhythmic arm movements and energetic steps, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. (2) The scene cuts to a young boy with short black hair wearing a cream-colored striped long-sleeved shirt and red trousers. He stands in the same environment and performs similar dance moves, swinging his arms and shifting his weight. (3) The boy is now shown wearing the oversized black spiked wig and sunglasses. He executes highly energetic dance moves, including exaggerated arm swings and side-to-side shuffles, while the camera pans slightly to track his motion across the floor. (4) In the final sequence, the boy continues his vigorous dancing but loses his balance, stumbling and eventually falling onto the wooden floor near the wardrobe doors. He appears to be laughing as he lands.
